description: Profit and loss (income statement) for any period: income, expenses by category and net income. Compare with another period: compare=previous-period or previous-year, or any period with compareFrom and compareTo. breakdown=month or quarter splits the period into columns.

bookId.description: The set of books, from list_books.

compareFrom.description: Start of any other period to compare with, yyyy-MM-dd.

period.description: A preset: this-month, last-month, this-quarter, last-quarter, this-fiscal-year, this-fiscal-year-to-date, last-fiscal-year. Or leave it empty and give from and to.

name: profit_and_loss
title: Profit and loss
